notes: These percentages describe acceptance-criterion coverage only. They are unrelated to browser code coverage in reports/coverage/, which measures which application JavaScript executed and is never evidence that an acceptance criterion is satisfied.
REQ-ETA-351-004 carries no acceptance criterion and therefore appears nowhere in this matrix. Its coverage is genuinely unknown, not zero and not complete. Tracked as CLR-TP-ETA-351-001.
AMB-ETA-351-004 and AMB-ETA-351-006 remain open human questions. Full coverage of the approved criteria does not mean every question about the story has been answered.
